newFindings: The sealed Phase 5.6 answers can be regenerated exactly (3/3 tasks, all fields) from the repository generator plus the published task set.
Two separate MATLAB MCP evaluate calls share one workspace: a canary set in one call was read in the next.
The parent session transcript is 34,075,136 bytes and mentions P56 task ids 2031 times; 12 episode transcripts (1,564,191 bytes) are readable and hash-unchanged.
Install roots are agent-reachable: a Qoder agent read .agents/skills/matlab-orchestrator/assets/routing.json through ordinary tools (Phase 5.7 Task 2).

options.name: non-owner local account + least-privilege ACL
options.mechanism: Run the client and MATLAB as a standard local user; ACL-deny evaluation assets, generator and transcripts to that account; grant only the arm's own workspace and skill root.
requires: MATLAB license for the second identity
client login/configuration for the second identity
residualRisks: arm can write its own profile between episodes
options.acceptanceGate: single-arm pilot: V1-V13 all BLOCKED and a positive control readable

options.name: Windows Sandbox or Hyper-V VM with MATLAB inside
options.mechanism: Snapshot per arm; only the task bundle is mapped read-only; no evaluation assets, skill roots or parent transcript; clipboard/network disabled except an approved license path.
residualRisks: license/toolbox and GPU availability must be verified
options.acceptanceGate: V1-V13 all BLOCKED and a positive control readable

options.name: remote ephemeral runner (CI/container)
options.mechanism: One-shot container/CI job per arm with only the task bundle mounted and a one-way result export.
requires: MATLAB container license and registry access
residualRisks: without MATLAB the task changes and the benchmark is invalid
no such service is authorized in this round

options.name: physical separation / manual one-way transfer
options.mechanism: Second machine with MATLAB and no network path to this host; task bundle in by removable media, results out manually.
residualRisks: not automatable for the current benchmark loop
options.acceptanceGate: V1-V13 all BLOCKED on the arm machine and a positive control readable
